title: Summoning demonstrations for the AARO director
summary: Jake Barber tells of Summoning demonstrations for the AARO director, about 2024-2025 at not stated, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We're doing demonstrations for the new director of Arrow. They're fully privy. They've seen our videos.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once flew a recovered UFO under his helicopter, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that his team was showing off its skill at calling up UFOs. He says that around 2024 and 2025 they were doing demonstrations for the new director of AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into UFO reports, and that the office was fully informed and had seen their videos. If true, it would mean the government's own UFO office is watching people summon these objects.
